_about: Curated cuisine knowledge base. Nutrition values are approximate per typical home portion. Tags in 'contains' drive diet/allergy filtering. Budgets are per person per day for groceries, in local currency.

cuisines.name: North Indian
cuisines.meal_pattern: Chai and a light breakfast (paratha, poha, chilla), lunch of dal-roti-sabzi-rice, evening chai with a snack, dinner similar to lunch.

dishes.name: Masala chai with milk and sugar

cuisines.name: Kashmiri
cuisines.meal_pattern: Noon chai with girda or tsot bread for breakfast, rice-centred lunch and dinner with haak and a yogurt or mutton dish, kahwa through the day.

dishes.name: Chaman kaliya (paneer in turmeric milk gravy)

cuisines.name: South Indian
cuisines.meal_pattern: Idli/dosa/upma breakfast with filter coffee, rice meals with sambar, rasam and poriyal at lunch and dinner, curd rice to finish.

cuisines.name: Bengali & East Indian
cuisines.meal_pattern: Light breakfast (luchi, muri, chira-doi), rice-dal-fish lunch, evening tea with jhalmuri, rice or roti dinner.

cuisines.name: Maharashtrian, Gujarati & Rajasthani
cuisines.meal_pattern: Poha/upma/thepla breakfast, thali-style lunch with dal-rice-bhakri-sabzi, chai and snack, lighter dinner.

cuisines.name: British
cuisines.meal_pattern: Cereal/porridge or toast for breakfast, a sandwich or soup lunch, tea and biscuits mid-afternoon, a cooked evening meal (often 'tea' or dinner around 6–7 pm).

cuisines.name: French
cuisines.meal_pattern: Light breakfast (tartine or croissant with coffee), a proper sit-down lunch with a main and vegetables, a small goûter, dinner around 8 pm. Lyon is known for bouchon dishes (quenelles, salade lyonnaise).

cuisines.name: Russian
cuisines.meal_pattern: Porridge, syrniki or open sandwiches for breakfast; lunch is the main meal with soup (borscht/shchi) then a main; a lighter dinner; tea throughout.

cuisines.name: Italian
cuisines.meal_pattern: Small sweet breakfast with coffee, lunch with pasta or a main, a light merenda, dinner around 8:30 pm.

cuisines.name: German
cuisines.meal_pattern: Bread rolls or muesli for breakfast, a warm lunch, coffee and cake mid-afternoon, a cold 'Abendbrot' of bread, cheese and cold cuts for dinner.

cuisines.name: American
cuisines.meal_pattern: Quick breakfast (eggs, oatmeal, cereal), sandwich or salad lunch, an afternoon snack, a cooked dinner around 6–7 pm.

cuisines.name: Mexican
cuisines.meal_pattern: Desayuno in the morning, the main meal (comida) in mid-afternoon, a light cena in the evening.

cuisines.name: Chinese
cuisines.meal_pattern: Congee, buns or soy milk for breakfast; rice with two or three shared dishes for lunch and dinner.

cuisines.name: Japanese
cuisines.meal_pattern: Rice, miso soup and fish or eggs for breakfast; a bento, noodles or donburi at lunch; ichiju-sansai style dinner (rice, soup, sides).

cuisines.name: Everyday home cooking
cuisines.meal_pattern: Breakfast, lunch, an afternoon snack and dinner.
